callerGraphNotes: Reference candidates are lexical evidence, not blindly equated with operational callers. The Markdown evidence resolves the changed chains and distinguishes deny-only/signed-history references.

retiredPathCallerGraph.basis: Unique baseline source-file to retired exact path/basename/Java-type edges after comment filtering; includes packaging, tests and current API pointer. Profile selectors are resolved separately in evidence section 4. Not execution counts.

compatibilityCallerAuthorization.analysis: JDK AST declaration/member references plus conservative typed-variable uses; comments and strings excluded; all new edges rejected, including methods in approved files.

activeExecutableInputCoverage.inspection: All active scripts/deploy/.github inputs inspected or exact safe-data classification; static local interpreter/direct-launcher inputs included; unknown types rejected.

safeInputs.reason: GitHub ownership metadata, never an executable input; exact bytes pinned.
